metaDescription: Order custom 17 oz towels for your brand. Perfect for gyms, hotels, and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 17 oz towels offer a substantial weight that feels luxurious and absorbs quickly, making them ideal for upscale spas, fitness centers, and hospitality brands. Unlike lighter towels, the 17 oz weight provides a plush, durable feel that stands up to frequent washing. Choose from ring-spun cotton or microfiber blends, and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a premium branded experience.
heroAltText: Stack of custom 17 oz towels in white and blue with embroidered logos
